scripts.clearSFC: find $(realpath .) -type f \( -name '*SFConf*' -o -name '*.sbak' \) | while read item; do echo "$item"; rm -f "$item"; done
scripts.l10n: echo Generating app_localizations_xx.dart from app_xx.arb; cd app && flutter gen-l10n
scripts.server-run-dev: echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Removing old data...; rm -fr server/data/*; fi; cd server && npm run dev
scripts.server-run-docker-local: echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Removing old data...; rm -fr serverDocker/data/*; fi; cd serverDocker; git pull; docker compose up -d --build server; docker compose logs -f server
scripts.server-run-docker-remote-mirror: cd serverDocker; sudo git pull; sudo env COMPOSE_PROGRESS=plain docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.coturn.yml up -d --build --build-arg NPM_MIRROR=https://registry.npmmirror.com --build-arg NODE_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/node --build-arg BETTER_SQLITE3_MIRROR=https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/better-sqlite3 server && docker compose logs -f server
scripts.server-update-remote: ssh.sh cn1 'cd /faronear/einz/; sudo git pull; npm run server-run-docker-remote-mirror'
scripts.app-apk-boot2run: ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; EMU_BIN="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/emulator/emulator"; if "$ADB" devices | grep -q 'emulator-5554'; then echo '✅ 模拟器 emulator-5554 已在运行，跳过启动'; else echo '▶ 启动模拟器 einz_emu（后台）…'; nohup "$EMU_BIN" -avd einz_emu >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo '▶ 等待 adb 设备上线…'; "$ADB" wait-for-device; echo '▶ 等待系统开机完成…'; until [ "$("$ADB" shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r')" = "1" ]; do sleep 2; done; echo '✅ 模拟器开机完成'; fi; printf '选择运行配置 [local / local-clean / remote / remote-clean]（回车默认 local）: '; if [ -n "$npm_config_mode" ]; then MODE="$npm_config_mode"; echo "$MODE"; else read -r MODE; fi; case "${MODE:-local}" in local) npm run app-apk-run-local;; local-clean) CLEAN=true npm run app-apk-run-local;; remote) npm run app-apk-run-remote;; remote-clean) CLEAN=true npm run app-apk-run-remote;; *) echo "未知配置: $MODE"; exit 1;; esac
scripts.app-apk-run-local: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Removing old data...; flutter install -d emulator-5554; fi; flutter run -d emulator-5554 --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.android.json --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_android.pid
scripts.app-apk-run-remote: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Removing old data...; flutter install -d emulator-5554; fi; flutter run -d emulator-5554 --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_android.pid
scripts.app-apk-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; echo; echo LEVEL=$LEVEL; echo 'Reloading Android App'; kill -USR$LEVEL $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter_android.pid)
scripts.app-apk-build: bash scripts/patchPubCache.sh && cd app; eval "$(node ../scripts/appVersion.js)" && flutter build apk --release --build-name "$APP_BUILD_NAME" --build-number "$APP_BUILD_NUMBER" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE="../_release.gitomit/einz-app-android-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.apk" && mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-release.apk $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Moved to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE
scripts.app-ios-boot-usage:
echo 'Usage:
 npm run app-ios-boot                       # 默认：Booted 优先，否则最新 iPhone
 npm run app-ios-boot -- ip17@27.0          # 短名@系统版本（推荐，跨机器通用）
 npm run app-ios-boot -- ip16@26.3          # iPhone 16 / iOS 26.3
 npm run app-ios-boot -- "iPhone 17"        # 写机型全名（不带版本取该机型最新）
 npm run app-ios-boot -- FF429526-A7EE-…    # 直接给 UDID
 EMU=ip17@27.0 npm run app-ios-boot         # 用环境变量改默认

短名: ip16 / ip16plus / ip16pro / ip16pm；ip17 / ip17pro / ip17pm / ip17air（见 scripts/emuResolveIos.js）

跑 App（默认打当前已启动的那台，纯 booted）：
 npm run app-ios-run-local
 EMU=ip17@27.0 npm run app-ios-run-local   # 临时指定某台（flutter 会自己 boot 它）
'
scripts.app-ios-run-local: UDID="$(bash scripts/emuUdidIos.sh "${EMU:-}")"; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then xcrun simctl uninstall "${UDID}" cc.tic.einz; fi; cd app; flutter run -d "${UDID}" --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.ios.json --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_ios.pid
scripts.app-ios-run-remote: UDID="$(bash scripts/emuUdidIos.sh "${EMU:-}")"; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then xcrun simctl uninstall "${UDID}" cc.tic.einz; fi; cd app; flutter run -d "${UDID}" --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_ios.pid
scripts.app-ios-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; echo; echo LEVEL=$LEVEL; echo 'Reloading iOS App'; kill -USR$LEVEL $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter_ios.pid)
scripts.app-ios-deps: cd app && flutter pub get && cd ios && pod install
scripts.app-ios-build-adhoc: bash app/ios/buildIos.sh adhoc && cd app && eval "$(cat build/ios/ipa/version.txt)" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE="../_release.gitomit/einz-app-ios-adhoc-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.ipa" && mv build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Moved to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE
scripts.app-ios-build-appstore: bash app/ios/buildIos.sh appstore && cd app && eval "$(cat build/ios/ipa/version.txt)" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE="../_release.gitomit/einz-app-ios-appstore-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.ipa" && mv build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Moved to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE
scripts.app-ios-build-raw: cd app; find build/ios -name '*.sbak' -print -delete 2>/dev/null; eval "$(node ../scripts/appVersion.js)" && flutter build ios --release --build-name "$APP_BUILD_NAME" --build-number "$APP_BUILD_NUMBER"&& eval "$(cat build/ios/ipa/version.txt)" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE="../_release.gitomit/einz-app-ios-raw-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.zip" && ditto -c -k --keepParent --sequesterRsrc build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Zipped to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE && rm -fr mv build/ios/iphoneos/Runner.app
scripts.app-ios-install-adhoc-ip11-steps: ls ~/Library/MobileDevice/Provisioning\ Profiles/; cd app; find build/ios -name '*.sbak' -print -delete 2>/dev/null; flutter build ipa --release --export-options-plist=ios/exportOptionsAdhoc.plist; ls -la build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa; xcrun devicectl list devices; rm -rf /tmp/einz-ipa && mkdir -p /tmp/einz-ipa; unzip -q build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa -d /tmp/einz-ipa; xcrun devicectl device install app --device 00008030-0005306011F9402E /tmp/einz-ipa/Payload/Runner.app
scripts.app-ios-install-adhoc-ip6s: bash app/ios/buildIos.sh adhoc && ideviceinstaller -u 01418b9159ab75651272f3e5616c3e3fc5dd7d1e install app/build/ios/ipa/einz.ipa
scripts.app-mac-build-raw: cd app && find build/macos -name '*.sbak' -print -delete 2>/dev/null; eval "$(node ../scripts/appVersion.js)" && flutter build macos --release --build-name "$APP_BUILD_NAME" --build-number "$APP_BUILD_NUMBER" && mkdir -p ../_release.gitomit && RELEASE=../_release.gitomit/einz-app-macos-raw-v${APP_BUILD_STAMP}.zip && ditto -c -k --keepParent --sequesterRsrc build/macos/Build/Products/Release/einz.app $RELEASE && echo && echo ======= Zipped to ======= && ls -lh $RELEASE && open build/macos/Build/Products/Release/einz.app --args --server http://localhost:3000
scripts.app-mac-run-local: cd app; echo "▶ macOS debug · 连 localhost:3000（路径①：--server 运行期覆盖，同 buildMacos.sh --server）· 数据落在容器内 dev/ 子目录 + 独立 Keychain 前缀，不碰正式客户端"; flutter run -d macos -a --server=http://localhost:3000 --dart-define=SHOW_MESSAGE_AVATARS=true --dart-define=einzDevDataDir=dev --dart-define=einzSecurePrefix=einz.secure.dev. --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_macos.pid
scripts.app-mac-run-localConfig: cd app; if [ ! -f localConfig.macos.json ]; then echo '❌ 缺 app/localConfig.macos.json，内容形如 {"kEinzServer":"http://localhost:3000"}'; exit 1; fi; echo "▶ macOS debug · 连 localConfig.macos.json 里的地址（路径②：--dart-define-from-file 编译期烘入）· 数据落在容器内 dev/ 子目录 + 独立 Keychain 前缀，不碰正式客户端"; flutter run -d macos --dart-define-from-file=localConfig.macos.json --dart-define=SHOW_MESSAGE_AVATARS=true --dart-define=einzDevDataDir=dev --dart-define=einzSecurePrefix=einz.secure.dev. --pid-file /tmp/einz_flutter_macos.pid
scripts.app-mac-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; echo; echo LEVEL=$LEVEL; echo 'Reloading Mac App'; kill -USR$LEVEL $(cat /tmp/einz_flutter_macos.pid)
scripts.app-all-reload: LEVEL=${LEVEL:-1}; npm run app-ios-reload; npm run app-apk-reload; npm run app-mac-reload;
scripts.tui2local: STORE=${STORE:-default}; echo STORE=$STORE; echo CLEAN=$CLEAN; if [ "$CLEAN" = "true" ]; then echo Removing old store...; rm -f cli/demo/store_$STORE.gitomit.sfomit.json; else echo Resume old store; fi; cd cli && dart run bin/einz_tui.dart --store demo/store_$STORE.gitomit.sfomit.json --server http://localhost:3000
